subject: Problems with lavTestLRT using the "MLM" estimator

messages.author: b48ebf16ed4cffef
messages.subject: Problems with lavTestLRT using the "MLM" estimator
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to compare pairwise hierarchical structural equation using the default model selection's strategy of lavaan with the lavTestLRT function, but my models use the estimator "MLM". Is there any problems for using this strategy, which returns me the "Chi-square" instead of the robust "Chi-square"? How can I specify the function's arguments to obtain the robust estimate? Or, is it better I use the lower AIC's value strategy? 

Thank y'all. 

...
Vinícius Silva de Alvarenga
Ecologist and Environmental Analyst (Federal University of Goiás, BR)

parts: Is there any problems for using this strategy, which returns me the "Chi-square" instead of the robust "Chi-square"? How can I specify the function's arguments to obtain the robust estimate?

Read the Details on the ?lavTestLRT help page.  If you requested a scaled test statistic, your LRT will be a scaled statistic too.
